name: Balthazar
source:
The king of Fasan, who was known for being ruthless and executing his own siblings.
He was assassinated before the story starts.
[spoiler]...except he wasn't. He faked his death, and the execution of his siblings was punishment for their capture and torture of several witches.[/spoiler]
